svg.title: Inside ctx->event_dag: vertices, edges and shared event objects
svg.desc: The DAG stores a vertex per event holding a shared_ptr, and directed edges between vertex indices. Other structures point at the same event objects.

g.text: From planner_core/event_dag.hpp. BuildActionGraph maps each motion back to its event with static_cast<ScheduleEventDag::Vertex>(motion.GetActionId()) (action_graph.cpp:390), which is why ctx->event_dag must never lose a vertex.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The example is the DAG of the topological-ordering figure (job 0 = a retrieve, jobs 1 and 2 repark T19). graph_ and vertex_by_node_ are Dag's two members; the holders on the right are illustrative.
